name: Aura
summary: AI website builder that turns prompts into landing pages, sites and UI sections, exportable as HTML or to Figma.
description: A design-first AI website builder: it generates landing pages, websites, UI sections and interactive web experiences from prompts, then supports visual editing, CMS page generation, custom domains, analytics, SEO metadata and publishing. Output exports as standard HTML, Tailwind CSS, vanilla JavaScript or Figma-ready files, with templates, components, assets and DESIGN.md systems usable as references.
contains: generates landing pages, websites, UI sections and interactive web experiences from prompts
exports standard HTML, Tailwind CSS, vanilla JavaScript and Figma-ready output
visual editing, CMS page generation, custom domains, analytics and SEO metadata
templates, components, assets, design systems and snippets as references
prompt-credit model: one prompt maps to one credit
